name: Atlar
description: Atlar is the AI-native treasury platform for finance teams, unifying cash management, payments, forecasting, bank reconciliation, and investments across 100+ countries of bank and ERP connections. This connector lets Claude query your live Atlar data, e.g. bank accounts, balances, cash flows, transactions, payments, forecasts, and treasury policies—with the same role-based permissions and audit trail as inside Atlar itself.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Atlar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Atlar to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.atlar.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Atlar MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Atlar lists 21 MCP tools, including balances, cash_flows, forecast, get_account_groups, get_bank_accounts, get_payment_details, get_transaction_details, get_treasury_policies, payment_statistics, query_approval_chains, query_categorization_rules, and query_credit_transfer_templates.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Atlar?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Atlar in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Atlar requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Atlar is developed by Atlar AB. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
